elements.requirement: This Chapter applies to proceedings in England and Wales or Northern Ireland brought by a member of a company in respect of a cause of action vested in the company and seeking relief on behalf of the company.
elements.quote: proceedings in England and Wales or Northern Ireland by a member of a company— (a) in respect of a cause of action vested in the company, and (b) seeking relief on behalf of the company

elements.requirement: Proceedings in England and Wales or Northern Ireland brought by a member of a company in respect of a cause of action vested in the company and seeking relief on behalf of the company are defined in this Chapter as a derivative claim.
elements.quote: This is referred to in this Chapter as a “derivative claim”

elements.requirement: A derivative claim may only be brought under this Chapter or pursuant to a court order made in unfair prejudice proceedings under section 994.
elements.quote: A derivative claim may only be brought— (a) under this Chapter, or (b) in pursuance of an order of the court in proceedings under section 994

elements.requirement: A derivative claim under this Chapter may only be brought in respect of a cause of action that arises from an actual or proposed act or omission involving negligence, default, breach of duty, or breach of trust by a director of the company.
elements.quote: arising from an actual or proposed act or omission involving negligence, default, breach of duty or breach of trust by a director of the company

elements.requirement: A cause of action forming the basis of a derivative claim may be brought against the director, against another person, or against both.
elements.quote: The cause of action may be against the director or another person (or both)

elements.requirement: A person seeking to bring or continue a derivative claim may do so regardless of whether the cause of action arose before or after that person became a member of the company.
elements.quote: immaterial whether the cause of action arose before or after the person seeking to bring or continue the derivative claim became a member of the company

elements.requirement: For the purposes of this Chapter, the term director includes any former director of the company.
For the purposes of this Chapter, a shadow director must be treated as a director of the company.
elements.quote: a shadow director is treated as a director

elements.requirement: For the purposes of this Chapter, any reference to a member of a company includes a person who is not a member but to whom shares in the company have been transferred or transmitted by operation of law.
elements.quote: references to a member of a company include a person who is not a member but to whom shares in the company have been transferred or transmitted by operation of law
